SECTION 2 — CONTEXT: WHAT VALIDATION MUST BECOME

Validation is currently the weakest part of the system. Based on the specification, validation must be a full intelligence operation that shows the user everything about their industry before they commit to a blueprint.
Shows generic output without real industry research
Does not run all 5 intelligence systems (CIS, IIS, EIS, SIS, PIS)
Has no deterministic verdict enforcement (PROCEED / ADJUST / PIVOT REQUIRED)
Does not feed validation output into the Blueprint Compiler
Has no tier-aware depth difference between Starter, Growth, and Ultimate
⚖ Validation is the only moment before execution where reality can stop a wrong direction. If validation is shallow, the entire blueprint runs on bad assumptions. This must be fixed completely.
SECTION 3 — THE 5 INTELLIGENCE SYSTEMS IN VALIDATION
All 5 AI intelligence systems must run during validation, in sequence. Each has a distinct role.
Understands the full system state. Maps the goal to a domain, industry, and niche. Provides execution context to all other systems. Must run first.
Refines and strengthens the goal. Rewrites vague input into a clean, measurable, execution-ready version. Generates alternative angles. Runs second.
THE CORE OF PHASE 3. Researches the industry in real time. Returns demand signals, competitive landscape, trends, saturation, risks, and strategic windows. Runs third.
Evaluates whether the direction is worth pursuing. Generates Current Path / Adjusted Path / Alternative Path. Checks goal vs real-world conditions. Runs fourth.
Forecasts likely outcomes given the goal, industry, and timeframe. Generates risk map. Produces probability scores (Ultimate tier). Runs fifth.
